answer: Trust compounds slowly. Influence equals account age times verified honest epochs: each period without fraud raises reputation, while proven deception resets it to zero. This caps what any new identity can do early, so a sybil attacker spawning thousands of fake agents gains no real signal for months. To make one agent matter, an attacker must operate it legitimately through every reputation summit, paying fees while it grinds upward, turning the cheap fable of mass fake identities into an expensive, slow, easily audited cost.
